headline: Prakash Pipes Limited: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Kanha Agarwal filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Code, indicating a substantial acquisition of shares in Prakash Pipes Limited, an NSE-listed industrial entity.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosure is mandatory when an acquirer crosses the 25% threshold; this filing marks the formal notification to the market and triggers mandatory offer obligations under the Takeover Regulations-a key structural gate for open-offer mechanics.
detail: Kanha Agarwal submitted a disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, relating to Prakash Pipes Limited. The disclosure indicates a substantial acquisition event triggering public notice requirements. Specific acquisition quantum, consideration, and related conditions are contained in the filed disclosure document archived on the NSE website.
